# The invoice of `fx_usd_overpayment_retargeted_setup.txt`, settled by naming
# the deposit that pays it exactly. No `prepayment:`, because nothing is left
# over: the whole receivable split moves into the invoice's lot.
#
# What that leaves is the one shape where an unpost's mark is the only thing
# standing between a settlement and being read as an owner's credit. Unposted,
# the transaction carries the bank side and one receivable split in a lot that
# now names no document — and with no second candidate beside it, the ambiguity
# guard has nothing to say. The next import either knows an unpost put it there
# or takes it for credit and strips the cost basis off currency the bank paid.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.

invoice "INV-USD-RETARGET"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-RETARGET"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-RETARGET"
